text:
liam: Hey infra — opened PR #4828 to add cross-region VPC peering + route updates so eu-west can reach the us-west GPU pool. Can someone take a quick look? https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4828

alex: on it, will skim after standup. any high-level risk notes?

liam: TL;DR: staging-tested, only adds peering and route entries for dedicated-prod VPCs, no public subnet changes. also a tiny IAM role tweak for route creation.

maya: does this change any NACLs or SGs that could impact data-plane?

liam: no SG/NACL changes. only `aws_vpc_peering_connection`, `aws_route` entries, and a new `iam_role` to allow route modifications by our infra agent.

ops-bot: CI started for PR #4828 — running terraform fmt, validate, plan, terratest.

terraform-bot: plan output (excerpt):
```
  # aws_route.peer_route will be created
  + resource "aws_route" "peer_route" {
      + cidr_block = "10.16.0.0/12"
      + gateway_id = (known after apply)
    }
```

ops-bot: terratest: 2 failing tests in module/vpc — see details in CI run.

alex: saw the failure logs, looks like a race in the test harness. not a config issue. i'll approve once CI green.

jordan: fyi, deployment for the batch-gpu job is scheduled for 2026-03-19 08:00 UTC; if this needs prod downtime we need to coordinate.

liam: no downtime expected. plan is to merge when approvals + CI pass; target merge window before that deploy if possible.

maya: i'll review IAM bits + least-privilege on the role. ping me if you want a stricter policy.

liam: thanks — pushed a fix for the terratest race (`tests/vpc/peer_test.go`) and addressed Alex's inline about duplicate `aws_route` resources.

ops-bot: CI rerun started for PR #4828.

terraform-bot: plan succeeded (no changes pending in staging preview).

alex: left one final small comment re: variable naming, otherwise LGTM.

liam: addressed and squashed. can someone approve when you have a sec? :pray:

maya: approving now. :white_check_mark:

alex: approving as well.

jordan: thanks — i'll add this to the rollout checklist and notify SRE on-call for the morning deploy.

liam: great, merging once GitHub actions finish final status checks. appreciate the quick reviews!
